latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of env-ops-standard for secure, policy-driven .env file management.

- Enforces a key-first, secret-safe workflow for adding, updating, listing, and removing .env entries.
- Never prints secret values; all set operations default to stdin-only and require explicit flags for value-in-argv or destructive changes.
- Mandates comment and naming conventions, policy validation, and atomic writes with timestamped backups.
- Includes commands for linting, health checks, dry-run previews, and policy inspection.
- Ensures org-wide consistency and safety, especially when troubleshooting missing keys or configuration errors.
